name: timeline-generator-scott-margetts
description: 从事项计划构建依赖网络和关键路径。生成交互式甘特图，标记接近关键的任务，并在发生延误时运行假设级联情景——展示项目影响并起草沟通函。为当地律师生成过滤后的工作流或法域视图。触发词：'build a timeline'、'Gantt chart'、'critical path'、'what if X is delayed'、'what moves if'、'schedule impact'、'how does this affect the programme'、'when do we finish'、'can we still close on time'、'if we miss this deadline'、'run a what-if'、'visualise the plan'、'Germany timeline'、'what does the Employment workstream look like'、'timeline for local counsel'、'just show me the [workstream] tasks'。
